delete from cfg_column_definition where table_id = #{tableId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and id not in #{it,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select c.table_id as tableId, c.id as fieldId, c.column_name as fieldName, c.column_comment as fieldComment, c.column_name as fieldAliasName, c.column_name as fieldValue, c.is_not_null as required, c.java_type as dataType, c.is_primary_key isPk from cfg_column_definition c where c.deleted = 0 and c.table_id in #{it}
select b.id, b.table_id tableId from cfg_module_table a, cfg_column_definition b where a.id=#{moduleTableId} and a.table_id = b.table_id and b.column_name=#{columnName}
